summary: OpenAI researcher describes GPT-5.6 Sol Ultra as a model that scales parallel test-time compute, cutting the time to generate a proof to a long-standing problem from about a day to about an hour.

mechanisms.reason: The model is described as scaling parallel test-time compute, meaning more compute is consumed per query to reduce wall-clock latency for reasoning tasks.
mechanisms.quote: GPT-5.6 Sol Ultra scales parallel ttc.

practices.reason: A stated wall-clock reduction for long-horizon reasoning/proof tasks would matter for latency-sensitive reasoning workloads, but the figure is hedged and unreplicated.
practices.quote: The time taken to generate a proof to a 50-year-old problem drops from perhaps a whole day to a single hour.

practices.reason: Parallel test-time compute is named as a technique but not described concretely enough to implement.
practices.quote: GPT-5.6 Sol Ultra scales parallel ttc.
